title: Workplace incident report
description: Fields a reporter must supply about one workplace incident.

reporter_name.description: Full name of the person making the report.

subject_name.description: Full name of the person the incident happened to.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth of the subject, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

incident_time.description: Time of the incident, 24-hour HH:MM; omitted when not stated.

phone.description: Reporter's contact number in E.164 for Australia.

site.description: Where the incident occurred, as named in the document.

injury_reported.description: Whether any injury to the subject is reported.

summary.description: What happened, in the reporter's own words.
